content:
Caroline: Heads-up — planning to ship the midnight slate (v2.4.1) to staging at 00:00 UTC. Need a short release-note blurb and an internal announce snippet. Can we pin staging by 23:45 UTC? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy created: v2.4.1 -> staging @ 2026-03-22T00:00:00Z. Canary 10%. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploys

Ben: Quick RN draft: \"Reduce token latency for short prompts by refining batching heuristics; misc docs and telemetry tweaks.\" Good? Any user-facing behavior to call out?

Alice: No user-visible API changes. Just perf and infra fixes. Main risk is a kv-cache edge-case that can spike 5xx on long-seq requests — we have a fallback patch that auto-rolls to v2.4.0 if errors spike.

David: Recommend explicit rollback criteria in the announce and runbook: if 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m OR p95 latency increases > 250ms for 10m -> immediate rollback to v2.4.0 and notify @oncall. Also list owner: @david.

Eva: I'll wire up a short dashboard and create an alert channel. Tagging @oncall in the watch policy. Will monitor canary and early staging traffic.

Frank: Suggest adding a QA note to the internal announce: please run the short_prompts smoke set and verify common pipelines. I'll post the sample commands.

Caroline: Copy for internal announce (first pass):

Caroline: \"Deploying v2.4.1 to staging at 00:00 UTC. Primary change: improved batching to lower latency on short prompts; no API/schema changes. Staged canary first, followed by a gradual rollout if metrics are green. Rollback criteria: 5xx > 0.5% (5m) OR p95 latency +250ms (10m). Owners: @david (rollback), @eva (monitoring), @caroline (release notes). If you see regressions, ping #oncall or reply here.\"

Caroline: Planned deploy commands (for ops):

Caroline: ```
/deploy schedule --env staging --version v2.4.1 --time 2026-03-22T00:00:00Z --canary 10%
/pin release staging v2.4.1 --until 2026-03-22T01:00:00Z
```

Ben: +1 to the blurb, maybe shorten the rollback line. Suggest: \"Auto-rollback if 5xx > 0.5% for 5m or p95 latency increases by >250ms for 10m.\"

Alice: Added note: we should call out the specific eval we ran: short_prompts_v1 (passing). Small line to paste into RN: \"Evals: short_prompts_v1 — no regression observed in staging sims.\"

Frank: QA command to run locally: `pytest tests/smoke/test_short_prompts.py -k smoke` and sample curl to hit staging: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $DEV_TOKEN\" https://staging.api.redwood/models/text/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":16}'`

Eva: Alert config pushed. I'll post the dashboard link in 5m. Also added a 15-min watch escalation to oncall if canary sees abnormal errors.

deploy-bot: Deploy schedule confirmed and staging pin applied. Canary rollout: 10% at 00:00 UTC, increase to 50% at +15m if health OK, full rollout at +60m.

David: I'll be standing by for rollback window 00:00–01:00 UTC. If we trigger rollback, I'll run: `/deploy rollback --env staging --to v2.4.0` and notify this channel.

Caroline: Internal announce ready to send at T-15m. Final blurb below — please thumbs-up if good: 

Caroline: \"[INTERNAL] Rolling out v2.4.1 to staging (00:00 UTC). Changes: batching improvements to reduce latency for short prompts; no API changes. Canary then staged rollout. Watch p95 latency and 5xxs — rollback will be triggered automatically if thresholds exceeded. Owners: @david, @eva, @caroline.\"

Ben: 👍

Frank: 👍 will run smoke after canary starts.

Eva: 👍 watching the dashboards.

Caroline: Thanks all — pin stays until 01:00 UTC, will update here after the 15m canary check.

deploy-bot: Note: reminder scheduled at T-15m to post the internal announce.

Caroline: (posting after canary): Canary looks clean at +15m — p95 stable, 5xx at 0.02%. Proceeding with staged increase to 50%.

David: Confirmed. Continuing monitoring.

Caroline: Final: rolling to 50% now. If anyone needs the RN snippet for external notes, DM me.
